mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO mdf_universe_snapshot (provider_code, canonical_symbol, symbol, name, market, total_market_cap, circulating_market_cap, turnover_rate, as_of_date, fetched_at) VALUES
(#{item.providerCode}, #{item.canonicalSymbol}, #{item.symbol}, #{item.name}, #{item.market}, #{item.totalMarketCap}, #{item.circulatingMarketCap}, #{item.turnoverRate}, #{item.asOfDate}, #{item.fetchedAt})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE symbol = VALUES(symbol), name = VALUES(name), market = VALUES(market), total_market_cap = VALUES(total_market_cap), circulating_market_cap = VALUES(circulating_market_cap), turnover_rate = VALUES(turnover_rate), fetched_at = VALUES(fetched_at)
mapper.select: SELECT canonical_symbol FROM mdf_universe_snapshot WHERE as_of_date = #{asOfDate} ORDER BY canonical_symbol
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mdf_universe_snapshot WHERE as_of_date = #{asOfDate}
